cloud_resource_caps.basis: V12 actual Kaggle T4x2 / cgroup 32,212,254,720-byte measurement; one T4 selected per worker
cloud_resource_caps.notes: Caps are based on observed Kaggle cloud capacity and preserve at least 20% headroom; they are operational ceilings, not measured H232 consumption. Actual device identity, affinity, cgroup, resource snapshots and phase heartbeats are mandatory.

input_identity.membership: fold0 expected counts: train fit 10,535; valid fit 1,405; evaluation 468

prior_receipt.reuse_policy: reuse full prior data SHA only if current canonical path and all device/inode/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns/mode fields exactly match; otherwise run original full hash and compare expected and portable registry SHA. Footer, assets, split, membership, and portable registry checks remain active.

input_identity.receipt: profile outputs include actual SHA-256, size, footer, and stat tuple for each read-only raw file; cross-kernel digest reuse is conditional on exact stat binding

loader_resource_change.verification: worker wraps the pinned dataloader_budget call and persists actual batch bytes, worker and prefetch values

next_gate: Independent root review of exact packet and source semantics, then fresh quota/resource admission; no push in this assembly.

numeric_policy_change.reason: V1 recorded one aggregate-only AMP skip at the default initial scale 65536; V2 makes the lower initial scale explicit and identifies every unscaled update result.
numeric_policy_change.scope: profile-only numeric diagnostic; fit not authorized

scientific_shape.input_view: full causal feature view; only H232's declared removal of --raw-only from E521 source recipe
scientific_shape.optimizer_loss_schedule: exact H232 frozen profile arguments; profile early-return only

scope: profile-only; no fit, checkpoint, prediction export, grading, or score

source_archive.unchanged_science: Only optional explicit GradScaler initialization and profile-only trace collection/return type changed; model, data, batch/sample order, objective, loss, optimizer, scheduler, clipping and all recipe settings remain unchanged.

update_evidence.data_reuse: The V1 raw hashes were measured once; V2 conditionally reuses them only on exact stat identity and has a full-hash fallback.
update_evidence.scale_evidence: Actual before/after scale tensors are captured on device; their per-attempt values are checked against the explicit scale/growth/backoff policy.
update_evidence.sync_policy: Device-side found_inf/loss flags and actual GradScaler._scale clones are accumulated asynchronously and transferred together once after the profile; no per-update host synchronization.
update_evidence.validity: All 200 timed update attempts must have finite loss and no unscaled found_inf. Warmup attempts and skips are separately counted and preserved; they are never conflated with timed attempts.
